injuries.name: Trevor van Riemsdyk
injuries.note: Van Riemsdyk got banged up a bit in Friday's game versus the Blue Jackets and will sit out the second half of the back-to-back. His absence will allow Spencer Stastney to make his Penguins debut. Van Riemsdyk is considered day-to-day ahead of Tuesday's game versus the Blackhawks.

injuries.name: Justin Brazeau
injuries.note: Brazeau is currently considered week-to-week while recovering from the lower-body injury he sustained in the preseason. The 28-year-old winger is coming off a career year, where he posted 17 goals, 34 points, 104 shots on net, 90 hits and 44 blocked shots across 64 regular-season outings. When he recovers, he'll likely factor into the Penguins' bottom six on a somewhat regular basis.

injuries.name: Ryan Graves
injuries.note: Graves will miss the beginning of the 2026-27 campaign, and it's unclear when he will be ready to return. He contributed one goal, 21 shots on net, 38 blocked shots and 23 hits in 22 regular-season appearances for Pittsburgh in 2025-26.

injuries.name: Riley Bezeau
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed F Riley Bezeau on injured reserve non-roster list.

injuries.name: Dante Fabbro
injuries.note: Upper-Body: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed D Dante Fabbro on injured reserve and is expected to miss at least a month, per Aaron Portzline of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Isac Lundestrom
injuries.note: Achilles: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed F Isac Lundestrom on long-term injured reserve and was labeled month-to-month by general manager Rick Bowness, per Mark Scheig of The Hockey Writers.

injuries.name: Caleb MacDonald
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed D Caleb MacDonald on non-roster injured reserve.

injuries.name: Ivan Provorov
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Columbus Blue Jackets placed D Ivan Provorov on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Justin Brazeau
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Pittsburgh Penguins placed F Justin Brazeau on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Ryan Graves
injuries.note: Lower-body: The Pittsburgh Penguins placed D Ryan Graves on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Andrei Kuzmenko
injuries.note: Personal: The Pittsburgh Penguins placed F Andrei Kuzmenko on injured reserve non-roster list on Wednesday (Oct. 7).

injuries.name: Bryan Rust
injuries.note: Upper-Body: The Pittsburgh Penguins said that Rust is considered a game-time decision ahead of Wednesday's (Oct. 7) matchup with Washington, per Josh Yohe of The Athletic.
